title: ACE — AI Campaign Engine
description: A premium AI-powered Game Master companion for Foundry VTT. Supports both D&D 5e 2014 and 2024 rules with automatic edition detection. Features real-time scene awareness, persistent campaign memory, NPC intelligence, dramatic narration with ElevenLabs TTS, encounter generation, proactive story suggestions, plus the full FaceTime-style NPC chat suite (bio generation, voice library, faction memory, conversation UI) merged from ACE: Envoy. System-agnostic with enhanced support for popular TTRPG systems.
